# Support and public intake

Use the repository's structured Issue Forms for reproducible defects and
bounded requests. Use Discussions for questions, ideas, and open-ended help
when that repository enables Discussions. Use private vulnerability reporting
for possible security issues.

Required form fields guide the normal GitHub web path. They are not a security
or schema firewall: issue bodies can be edited and API or CLI clients can
submit arbitrary text. Never post secrets, credentials, private logs, customer
data, or signed URLs.

There is no guaranteed response-time SLA or roadmap commitment. A maintainer's
triage decision, not an automated acknowledgement, establishes next action.
